headline: Attackers exploited Mitel MiCollab zero-days and a second Drupal installer gap as Italy and Switzerland warned of autonomous AI-driven attacks on critical infrastructure.

emerging_trends.text: Accenture ties the MiCollab intrusions to AI-assisted exploit development, part of a pattern of edge and collaboration gear falling before vendors ship advisories.
Italy and Switzerland join Britain and India in warning that autonomous AI agents now attack critical infrastructure faster than defenders can patch.
emerging_trends.topic_title: Italy and Switzerland Flag Autonomous AI Attacks

emerging_trends.text: Thirteen malicious NuGet packages hidden in fake job assessments show attackers recruiting developers as the entry point into company source code.
emerging_trends.topic_title: Fake Job Tests Hide Malicious NuGet Packages

topics.title: Attackers Exploit Mitel MiCollab Zero-Days
topics.latest_developments: Accenture said hackers exploited Mitel MiCollab flaws before Mitel published its advisory, likely with AI assistance, in a suspected extortion campaign.
topics.why_it_matters: MiCollab servers carry voice, chat, and directory data for entire organizations, and the attacks ran while no patch existed.

details.label: By the numbers
details.text: CISA added 10 flaws to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on Wednesday, among them five MiCollab bugs plus Juniper, Vates, and Danfoss products.

details.label: What to do
details.text: Patch MiCollab and audit the Audio, Web and Video Conferencing component for uploaded files under CVE-2026-133275. Pull management interfaces off the internet.

sources.title: Mitel MiCollab Zero-Days Exploited in Suspected AI-Assisted Attacks
Hackers Exploit 10 Vulnerabilities Across Mitel, Juniper, Vates, and Danfoss Products
CISA warns of critical unpatched flaw in Danfoss refrigeration controllers

topics.title: Drupal Patch Gap Leaves Sites Exploitable
topics.latest_developments: Drupal disclosed CVE-2026-136716, a highly critical flaw already exploited in the wild, because its earlier Fail2Install fix left some sites in vulnerable installation states.
topics.why_it_matters: Site owners who applied the first patch and declared victory still face unauthenticated takeover across government, university, and media deployments.

details.label: What to do
details.text: Update Drupal core a second time. Hunt for unexpected site reinstalls, new administrator accounts, and changes to settings files.

details.label: Flashback
details.text: Attackers have exploited the original bug, CVE-2026-132165, since at least November 19, and CISA set a November 27 deadline for federal agencies.

sources.title: Drupal Warns of New Highly Critical Site Takeover Vulnerability Under Active Exploitation
Drupal Installer Patch Left a Gap Attackers Are Already Exploiting
Critical Drupal installer flaw under active attack (CVE-2026-132165)

topics.title: 1Password Says Attacker Copied Source Code
topics.latest_developments: 1Password said the attacker who hijacked an employee's corporate GitHub account copied source code from private repositories plus account records, and the investigation began November 19, 2026.
topics.why_it_matters: Stolen customer names and emails give phishers a vetted list of password manager users to impersonate 1Password against.

details.label: Zoom in
details.text: The attacker pushed malicious code into backend services before containment. 1Password says customer vaults and other secrets stayed inaccessible.

details.label: What to do
details.text: Verify any 1Password support contact through the company's own site, and review GitHub account protections for developers with production access.

sources.title: 1Password Hacked, Customer Data and Source Code Stolen in GitHub Account Breach
1Password breached through hijacked employee GitHub account, customer names and emails stolen
1Password Breach Exposes Customer Data, Internal Source Code

topics.title: Fake Job Tests Hide Malicious NuGet Packages
topics.latest_developments: Socket researcher Kush Pandya found 13 malicious NuGet packages posing as WinUI 3 and Windows Presentation Foundation button controls inside fake take-home job assessments.
topics.why_it_matters: Building or running the sample project hands attackers access to a .NET developer's machine, and from there to source code and credentials.

details.label: What to do
details.text: Treat recruiter-supplied projects as untrusted code. Build them in disposable virtual machines and restrict developers to vetted package feeds.

sources.title: 13 Malicious NuGet Packages Turn Fake .NET Job Assessments Into Malware Delivery Traps
Attackers Target .NET Developers With Poisoned Job Assessments

topics.title: SYS010 Malware Hijacks Browser Enterprise Management
topics.latest_developments: A new version of the SYS01 infostealer, SYS010, enrolls victim browsers into enterprise-style management to force-install an extension that steals data.
topics.why_it_matters: The forced extension reads Gmail and Outlook mail, turning an ad click into persistent mailbox surveillance with no user consent prompt.

details.label: Zoom in
details.text: Operators deliver the malware through Meta ads, the same channel earlier SYS01 campaigns used to reach business account holders.

details.label: What to do
details.text: Alert on new browser cloud management policies and enrollment profiles appearing on endpoints, and block extension installs outside an approved list.

sources.title: SYS010 malware abuses browser management to spy on Gmail, Outlook

topics.title: Italy and Switzerland Flag Autonomous AI Attacks
topics.latest_developments: The Swiss and Italian national cyber agencies warned that attacks driven by autonomous AI agents are hitting critical infrastructure organizations in both countries.
topics.why_it_matters: Agent-driven attacks compress reconnaissance and exploitation into minutes, outrunning patch cycles and human-speed triage at utilities, transport, and manufacturing operators.

details.label: What to do
details.text: Unit 42 tells teams to baseline normal behavior and push detection to the edge, since agent-speed intrusions leave no room for manual review.

details.label: What to watch
details.text: Cyber insurers now sort clients into AI-defense haves and have-nots and say the current policy model cannot hold.

sources.title: Italy and Switzerland warn of autonomous AI-driven cyberattacks
The AI Threat Horizon: Why Speed, Edge AI and Baselines Are Our Best Defense
Cyber Insurers See New Divide: AI Defense 'Haves' & 'Have Nots'

business_politics.title: Bank of England Proposes Capital Cut
business_politics.latest_developments: The Bank of England proposed cutting United Kingdom bank capital requirements Thursday, November 26, releasing capital for dividends, buybacks, and lending.
business_politics.why_it_matters: The change frees British lenders to return more cash to shareholders and extend more credit to households and businesses.

details.label: Between the lines
details.text: The same central bank warned Thursday that the scale and breadth of artificial-intelligence financing leaves the global financial system more vulnerable to setbacks.

sources.title: Bank of England Proposes Cut to U.K. Bank Capital Requirements
BOE Warns Scale and Breadth Of AI Financing Poses Threat to Financial Stability

business_politics.title: China Threatens Retaliation Over Trump Tariffs
business_politics.latest_developments: China warned Thursday, November 26, that it could retaliate against President Trump's new tariffs, and Japan and other trading partners lodged protests.
business_politics.why_it_matters: Retaliation would unwind the trade truce reached at the Shenzhen summit and raise input costs across global supply chains.

details.label: Zoom in
details.text: The administration clarified that the new duties supersede earlier tariffs on China and dozens of other nations.

details.label: Between the lines
details.text: Asian and European indexes opened sharply higher and United States futures climbed as investors shrugged off the plan before the Thanksgiving break.

sources.title: New Tariffs on China Risk Undermining Trade Truce With U.S.
China hits back at Trump tariff threat
U.S. Stock Futures Higher as AI Trade Steadies for Thanksgiving Break

business_politics.title: UniCredit Clears Final Commerzbank Hurdle
business_politics.latest_developments: UniCredit said Thursday, November 26, that Poland's financial regulator approved its Commerzbank takeover, satisfying the last regulatory condition for the deal.
business_politics.why_it_matters: The deal hands Italy's UniCredit control of a major German lender and completes one of Europe's largest cross-border bank combinations.

details.label: Zoom in
details.text: UniCredit is seeking the Commerzbank chair role for Chief Executive Andrea Orcel.

sources.title: UniCredit Seeks Commerzbank Chair Role for CEO Orcel After Takeover Clears Final Hurdle

business_politics.title: Nvidia Halts Chips to Southeast Asia
business_politics.latest_developments: Nvidia stopped chip shipments to southeast Asia, the Financial Times reported Thursday, November 26, as Washington tightens export controls on Chinese access to artificial-intelligence computing.
business_politics.why_it_matters: Data-center operators across the region lose access to Nvidia hardware, and the curbs tighten policing of routes that reach Chinese buyers.

sources.title: Nvidia halts chip shipments to south-east Asia

business.title: Online Deals Blunt Black Friday Rush
business.latest_developments: KDKA's Barry Pintar visited South Hills Village Mall Wednesday, November 25, and found the in-store Black Friday rush thinned as online shopping spreads discounts across the season.
business.why_it_matters: Pittsburgh-area retailers lean on the weekend after Thanksgiving for holiday sales, and foot traffic now arrives later and lighter.

details.label: Zoom in
details.text: WTAE is tracking Amazon discounts that hit record-low prices and published a checker tool so shoppers can test whether a listed deal is the year's lowest.

business.title: Fern Hollow Unveils $2.5 Million Expansion
business.latest_developments: Fern Hollow Nature Center unveiled a $2.5 million expansion in Sewickley Heights, TribLive reported Thursday, November 26, and named its largest classroom for the center's late founder.
business.why_it_matters: The environmental education center gains classroom capacity for school groups and programs serving the Sewickley area.

around_town.title: Thanksgiving Storm Brings Rain and Wind
around_town.latest_developments: Steady rain and gusty winds reached Western Pennsylvania before sunrise Thursday, November 26, and WTAE declared an Impact Day for Thanksgiving.
around_town.why_it_matters: Holiday drivers across the Pittsburgh region face wet, windy roads on one of the year's busiest travel days, with the Pennsylvania Turnpike already carrying out-of-state traffic.

details.label: When
details.text: WPXI has rain continuing off and on through early afternoon before it clears.

details.label: Zoom in
details.text: Macy's pushed its Thanksgiving Day Parade in New York to Saturday, the first weather postponement in the parade's 100-year history.

around_town.title: Harrison Budget Holds Property Taxes Flat
around_town.latest_developments: Harrison commissioners approved a proposed 2027 budget that holds real estate taxes steady, TribLive reported Thursday, November 26.
around_town.why_it_matters: Harrison property owners keep their current tax bills, and commissioners must cover 2027 costs without new revenue.

sources.title: Preliminary budget shows no property tax increase in Harrison

around_town.title: Humane Animal Rescue Feeds Pets, Owners
around_town.latest_developments: Humane Animal Rescue of Pittsburgh handed out pet food along with Thanksgiving meals for owners, WPXI reported Thursday, November 26.
around_town.why_it_matters: The giveaway helps Pittsburgh households stretched by grocery costs keep their animals at home through the holiday.

events.why_it_matters: Western Pennsylvania high school football crowns its champions on the Steelers' field two days after Thanksgiving.

details.text: Three other area teams play PIAA playoff games the same weekend, per TribLive's Week 14 matchups.
